name: live-tennis
title: Live Tennis
description: Live tennis scores, upcoming fixtures and player rankings for ATP, WTA, Challenger and ITF, powered by the Live Tennis API
author: bensynapse

commands.name: live-matches
commands.title: Live Matches
commands.subtitle: Live Tennis
commands.description: In-play matches with current score, server and break-point indicator

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: Auto-Refresh
preferences.description: How often the live list refreshes while the command is open. Each refresh is one API request — the free tier allows 100 requests per day, so slower is safer.

commands.name: search-players
commands.title: Search Players
commands.subtitle: Live Tennis
commands.description: Look up players and their current ranking

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Live Tennis API key. The free tier (no card required) is enough for every command in this extension — sign up at livetennisapi.com.
